== Enhanced Jabba’s Palace original printing ==
The physical Enhanced Jabba’s Palace card photographs and product entry identify this printing as a Decipher card. The product was released in January 2000.<ref name="ejp-physical-publication">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=25 Star Wars CCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], page 25, Enhanced Jabba’s Palace: “Released: January 2000”; original premium card photographs.</ref> Era is corrected to Decipher era; the existing January 2000 Released citation and Decipher publisher are retained. Versions labels for this original printing are corrected to the Decipher band. — [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] 19 November 2026 (UTC)
